## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and affected packages or tool pins.

## Validation

List the synthetic tests or checks run and any checks still needed. Runtime or tool-profile changes also need exact-image validation in an authorized Cloudflare account before release.

- [ ] No credentials, private target details or assessment evidence are included.
- [ ] Relevant tests, types, notices and version/image compatibility were checked.
- [ ] Security concerns were reported privately following [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
